alerts.header: Line 1 Yonge-University: There will be no subway service between Finch West and Wilson stations, starting 11:59 p.m., nightly Thursday, November 19 to Friday, November 20, due to planned track work. Shuttle buses will operate.
Line 2 Bloor-Danforth: On Saturday, November 21, there will be no subway service between St George and Broadview stations, due to for planned signal work. Shuttle buses will operate.
Line 2 Bloor-Danforth: No service between Woodbine and Broadview stations due to a medical emergency Shuttle buses are on the way. Thank you for your patience.
